scope: 291 canonical Q&A owners; no Catechism; indexed research records and overlapping debate expansions are not counted as separate questions
methodology: Candidate books assigned from author/title/subject and module topic fit only, without validating chapters, exact passages or Q&A claims
Historical apologetics never satisfies postconciliar Church Crisis primary-evidence requirements on its own
CSE historical natural-law or marriage references do not verify contemporary clinical, scientific, digital, biological or pastoral claims
Source-role independence is by authorship/original publisher, not URL count; repeated works by Newman and Chesterton are not additional independent witnesses
Proponent positions and historical factual claims require original opponent documents and independent scholarly corroboration
This is a separate research mapping; it does not alter live answers, existing source register, canonical ownership, or release gates
